title: ClunoGS: Compact Language 3D Gaussian Splatting via Unified Optimization
abstract: Language 3D Gaussian Splatting enables open-vocabulary scene understanding by associating Gaussian primitives with language features. These semantic attributes increase model storage, while most existing 3DGS compression methods are designed mainly to preserve RGB rendering quality. One straightforward approach is to apply sparsification and quantization sequentially. However, pruning based only on rendering quality can remove Gaussians that have small RGB contributions but are important for semantic prediction. Once removed, their semantic information cannot be recovered by later quantization. We propose ClunoGS, a compact framework for Language 3DGS that combines semantics-aware Gaussian sparsification and vector quantization in a unified constrained objective. Semantic supervision is used during sparsification, and the objective jointly considers rendering quality, semantic accuracy, and compactness. We optimize the unified objective with alternating primal, sparsification, quantization, and dual updates. We evaluate ClunoGS on open-vocabulary localization and segmentation using the LERF and ScanNet-10 benchmarks. Under aggressive compression, our unified, semantics-aware formulation substantially alleviates the degradation of semantic representations caused by sequential compression and semantics-agnostic Gaussian sparsification. Ablations further show that jointly coordinating sparsification and quantization better preserves semantic accuracy than applying them independently.
tldr: ClunoGS通过语义感知稀疏化与向量量化的统一优化，实现紧凑语言3DGS并缓解语义退化。
motivation: 语言3DGS通过为高斯基元关联语言特征支持开放词汇场景理解，但显著增加模型存储，而现有3DGS压缩方法主要面向RGB渲染质量。若按渲染贡献先稀疏化再量化，可能删除RGB贡献小但对语义预测重要的高斯，且其语义信息在后续量化前已不可恢复。
method: ClunoGS提出统一约束目标，将语义感知高斯稀疏化与向量量化联合优化，目标同时考虑渲染质量、语义准确性和紧凑性，并在稀疏化过程中引入语义监督。优化采用原始变量、稀疏化、量化和对偶变量的交替更新。
result: 在LERF和ScanNet-10的开放词汇定位与分割任务上，激进压缩下该统一语义感知方案显著缓解了顺序压缩和语义无关稀疏化造成的语义表示退化；消融实验表明联合协调稀疏化与量化比独立执行更能保持语义精度（摘要未提供具体数值指标）。
conclusion: ClunoGS为语言3DGS提供紧凑化框架，其核心贡献是以统一优化联合协调稀疏化与量化，兼顾渲染质量、语义准确性和存储效率。该方法有望降低开放词汇3D场景理解模型的存储开销并提升实际部署可行性。

title: DewHand: Direct Metric World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
abstract: Recovering metric world-space hand motion from egocentric video supports understanding human interactions and transferring them to embodied agents. Three challenges complicate this task: multi-stage pipelines propagate errors from independently estimated hand and camera motion; monocular observations leave physical scale ambiguous; and occlusion and out-of-view hands admit multiple plausible motion trajectories. We present DewHand, a unified model for direct joint reconstruction of world-space hand and camera motion. To avoid compounding errors from multi-stage estimation, DewHand jointly predicts hand and camera motion in a shared world coordinate system within a single-stage pipeline. To resolve metric-scale ambiguity, it combines scene-level geometric features from VGGT-$Ω$ with metric-space supervision, while hand-specific features preserve fine-grained articulation. To handle occlusion and out-of-view hands, we formulate reconstruction as conditional motion generation with flow matching. Under the same architecture, this generative formulation outperforms direct regression in both accuracy and temporal smoothness with only two sampling steps. Experiments on HOT3D and ARCTIC demonstrate improved world-space accuracy and temporal consistency over state-of-the-art methods. DewHand reduces rigid-aligned world-space error relative to StableHand from 32.9 to 28.4 mm on HOT3D and from 76.2 to 36.2 mm on ARCTIC. It also recovers camera scale within 10% on two thirds of HOT3D clips, versus about a quarter for SLAM. Moreover, in zero-shot evaluations on HoloAssist, H2O, and TACO, captured with different devices, DewHand achieves the lowest rigid-aligned world-space error (WA-MPJPE) on each dataset.
tldr: DewHand 单阶段联合重建度量世界空间手部与相机运动，提升精度与时序一致性。
motivation: 从第一视角视频恢复度量世界空间手部运动对理解人类交互并迁移至具身智能体至关重要，但现有多阶段流程会传播手部与相机独立估计误差，单目观测存在尺度歧义，遮挡与出画手部又导致多解。
method: DewHand 在单一阶段流程中于共享世界坐标系联合预测手部与相机运动；它融合 VGGT-Ω 的场景级几何特征与度量空间监督以消解尺度歧义，并保留手部专用特征以维持细粒度关节；同时将重建建模为基于 flow matching 的条件运动生成，仅需两步采样。
result: 在 HOT3D 和 ARCTIC 上，DewHand 将相对 StableHand 的刚性对齐世界空间误差从 32.9 mm 降至 28.4 mm、从 76.2 mm 降至 36.2 mm，并提升时序一致性；HOT3D 中三分之二片段相机尺度误差在 10% 内（SLAM 约四分之一）。在 HoloAssist、H2O、TACO 零样本评测中，各数据集 WA-MPJPE 均为最低。
conclusion: DewHand 表明单阶段联合重建结合度量几何监督与生成式 flow matching 可有效缓解误差累积、尺度歧义和遮挡多解问题，并在跨设备零样本场景取得最优世界空间精度，为第一视角手部运动理解与具身迁移提供新路线。

title: GeoMem-VLA: Internalizing 3D Scene Understanding into Temporal Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.
tldr: GeoMem-VLA 将显式3D几何监督内化为几何token，并作为时序记忆持续更新，用于机器人动作生成。
motivation: 多数VLA模型仅依赖当前观测的2D表征，而几何感知方法需额外3D输入；逐帧独立推断的几何信息往往被丢弃，未能累积为持久任务表征。作者认为动作生成真正需要的是紧凑、任务相关且可连续更新的几何抽象，而非每步完整的可渲染3D重建。
method: 提出GeoMem-VLA框架：用冻结的几何基础模型通过几何流匹配目标，对可学习的GeoPlan token进行监督，覆盖当前场景点图与未来末端执行器轨迹，但不直接对齐VLM原生视觉嵌入与教师特征空间。这些几何token与观测表征记忆集成：历史信息被检索、与当前观测自适应融合，并随任务推进将事件帧固化保存。推理时不调用3D教师模型、不显式重建场景，仅检索历史表征并与当前工作表征融合来预测动作。
result: 经基准特定下游适配后，LIBERO平均成功率98.9%；RoboTwin干净与随机化设置分别为91.10%和91.24%；五个真实世界任务平均成功率78.0%。
conclusion: 结果表明显式3D监督可被内化为紧凑几何token，并借助时序记忆持续保留；这种内化与记忆3D场景理解的范式是机器人控制的有效途径，且推理阶段无需3D教师或场景重建，具备实际部署潜力。

title: UniRAP: Towards Unified Part-level Physical Affordance Reasoning and Actionable Perception
abstract: Vision-language perception has achieved impressive progress in aligning natural language with visual observations, yet grounding high-level semantics into part-level physical interaction remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose UniRAP, a unified model for inferring part-level physical affordances and mapping language instructions to actionable geometric representations. UniRAP formulates this problem as a conditional multimodal generation task, integrating visual inputs, textual instructions, and optional prompts into a shared spatiotemporal representation space through a unified interface token mechanism. To predict executable contact geometry, we introduce a Unified Affordance Decoder (UAD), which jointly performs object detection, part-level affordance segmentation, and 4-DoF interaction pose estimation by leveraging intermediate segmentation features. In addition, we propose a curriculum-based transfer training strategy that progressively adapts the model from general visual parsing to interaction-aware perception, improving data efficiency under limited textual annotations. Experiments show that UniRAP achieves state-of-the-art performance on referring expression segmentation, affordance grounding, and interaction pose estimation, while maintaining strong spatiotemporal consistency in dynamic video scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of UniRAP as a unified perception framework for language-guided physical manipulation.
tldr: 提出统一模型UniRAP，实现部件级物理可供性推理与语言引导的可操作几何感知。
motivation: 现有视觉-语言感知虽能对齐语言与视觉，但难以将高层语义落到部件级物理交互；需统一推理部件可供性并将指令映射为可执行几何表示。
method: UniRAP将问题建模为条件多模态生成，借统一接口token融合视觉、文本及可选提示到共享时空表示；Unified Affordance Decoder利用中间分割特征联合完成目标检测、部件级可供性分割与4-DoF交互位姿估计，并采用课程式迁移训练从通用视觉解析渐进到交互感知。
result: 实验在指代表达分割、可供性定位和交互位姿估计上达到SOTA，并在动态视频场景保持较强时空一致性；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明UniRAP可作为语言引导物理操作的有效统一感知框架，贡献在于统一部件级可供性推理与可操作几何输出，并提升有限文本标注下的数据效率。

title: AutoPhyX: Automatic Text-Condition Physics Property Generation
abstract: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties. Previous methods struggle with critical bottlenecks: they either rely on computationally intensive per-scene optimization or predict parameters from purely visual inputs. The latter suffers from inherent ambiguity, e.g., the inability to distinguish the stiffness of rubber from its appearance alone. To bridge this gap, we propose AutoPhyX, a text-conditioned framework for predicting spatially-varying physical properties. Since training robust feed-forward models requires fine-grained supervision, we first introduce a novel part-controllable data generation pipeline that decomposes complex 3D assets into semantically distinct components and pairs them with physically plausible, diverse parameters and corresponding text descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, AutoPhyX employs a cross-modal modulation mechanism where text features dynamically modulate visual features for precise physical grounding. By formulating property prediction within a voxel field, AutoPhyX ensures compatibility with diverse 3D representations, including meshes, point clouds, Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF. Experiments demonstrate that our method enables physically plausible, text-driven parameter assignment in a single forward pass. It achieves high accuracy and robust generalization to in-the-wild objects, paving the way for future physics-intensive embodied and robotic applications.
tldr: AutoPhyX 通过文本条件与跨模态调制，单次前向预测空间变化的物理属性。
motivation: 高保真 4D 物理仿真需要与多样材质属性一致的空间物理参数，但已有方法要么依赖计算昂贵的逐场景优化，要么仅从视觉输入预测参数，存在固有歧义，例如仅凭外观难以区分橡胶的刚度。该工作引入文本条件来弥补视觉信息不足，实现更准确的物理属性 grounding。
method: AutoPhyX 首先提出部件可控的数据生成流水线，将复杂 3D 资产分解为语义部件，并配以物理合理且多样的参数与对应文本描述；随后采用跨模态调制机制，用文本特征动态调制视觉特征以进行精确物理 grounding。方法在体素场中建模属性预测，从而兼容 mesh、点云、Gaussian Splatting 和 NeRF 等多种 3D 表示。
result: 实验表明，AutoPhyX 能在单次前向传播中完成物理合理、文本驱动的参数赋值，并取得较高准确率及对 in-the-wild 物体的稳健泛化能力；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作贡献了部件可控的物理属性数据生成流水线与文本条件预测框架，实现单次前向的空间变化物理属性生成，为物理密集型具身智能与机器人应用提供了基础。

title: BlazeVGGT: 13x Faster VGGT at 2,000 Frames via Camera Token without Training
abstract: Feed-forward visual geometry models, exemplified by VGGT, have demonstrated strong multi-view reconstruction capabilities through dense global attention. However, the resulting all-to-all cross-view computation scales quadratically with the number of input views, making long-sequence inference particularly expensive due to substantial frame-level redundancy among highly overlapping observations. We uncover a topology-first, geometry-later evolution in VGGT camera tokens: shallow-layer tokens reliably capture local view neighborhoods, whereas deeper-layer tokens progressively encode globally organized inter-view geometry. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BlazeVGGT, a training-free framework for structure-aware frame-level key--value sparsification. At each global-attention block, BlazeVGGT constructs a view-level similarity kernel from camera-token relations and employs greedy determinantal point process inference to select a compact set of mutually complementary views. The selected views constitute the key--value context, while all input frames are retained as queries. This asymmetric attention design preserves dense per-frame predictions while eliminating redundant cross-view computation, allowing our method to be directly integrated into pretrained VGGT as a plug-and-play module without parameter updates. Its advantages become increasingly pronounced with sequence length: at 2,000 frames, BlazeVGGT achieves approximately 13$\times$ faster inference than VGGT while reducing the Chamfer Distance from 0.41 to 0.32. Extensive experiments demonstrate a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off in point-cloud reconstruction and camera-pose estimation, compatibility with existing VGGT accelerators such as FastVGGT and LiteVGGT, and transferability to VGGT-based models including StreamVGGT and PAGE-4D. Codes are publicly available at https://github.com/MagiciannnY/BlazeVGGT.git.
tldr: BlazeVGGT 利用相机 token 选择互补视角，实现免训练、2000 帧下约 13 倍加速的 VGGT 推理。
motivation: VGGT 等前馈视觉几何模型依赖稠密全局注意力，跨视图全连接计算随输入视图数呈二次增长，长序列推理因高度重叠观测的帧级冗余而异常昂贵。研究旨在不重新训练的前提下减少冗余跨视图计算，同时保留逐帧稠密预测能力。
method: 作者发现 VGGT 相机 token 呈“先拓扑、后几何”演化：浅层可靠捕捉局部视图邻域，深层逐步编码全局视图几何。BlazeVGGT 在每个全局注意力块中由相机 token 关系构建视图级相似度核，并用贪心行列式点过程（DPP）选择一组互补视图作为 key-value 上下文，所有输入帧仍作为 query，形成非对称注意力，可直接作为即插即用模块接入预训练 VGGT 且无需参数更新。
result: 在 2,000 帧输入下，BlazeVGGT 推理速度约为 VGGT 的 13 倍，并将 Chamfer Distance 从 0.41 降至 0.32。实验表明其在点云重建和相机位姿估计上取得较好的精度—效率权衡，兼容 FastVGGT、LiteVGGT 等现有加速器，并可迁移到 StreamVGGT、PAGE-4D 等 VGGT 类模型。
conclusion: BlazeVGGT 提出免训练、结构感知的帧级 key-value 稀疏化框架，通过相机 token 引导的互补视图选择消除冗余跨视图计算。其贡献在于以即插即用方式显著加速长序列 VGGT 推理并提升部分几何指标，对长序列多视图重建和现有 VGGT 生态具有潜在影响。

title: Progressive Permutation Alignment with Temperature-Controlled Spectral Sharpening
abstract: In implicit neural representations (INRs), 3D signals are encoded directly in network weights, making stable weight-space operations essential. However, permutation symmetry causes independently trained yet functionally equivalent models to appear distant in weight space, often inducing large loss barriers under linear interpolation. Existing neuron alignment methods either commit early to discrete matches and become trapped in inconsistent local optima or rely on computationally expensive gradient optimization over continuous relaxations, both of which are unreliable in challenging cases such as NeRF. We adopt progressive alignment, a layer-wise strategy that follows inter-layer dependencies from input to output. At each layer, a correlation matrix is estimated and aligned with a discrete anchor obtained by the Hungarian algorithm, after which temperature-controlled spectral annealing gradually sharpens the correlation structure toward a permutation matrix. This update is deterministic and lightweight, avoiding the inner-loop gradient optimization required by continuous relaxation methods. A final refinement stage further optimizes the network layer-by-layer via weight matching, starting from the aligned solution. Experiments on MLPs, CNNs, and Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) show that the proposed method reliably recovers neuron correspondences and achieves stable alignment across architectures. In practical experiments aligning independently trained NeRF models, our method reduces the loss barriers under weight interpolation compared with existing approaches.
tldr: 提出逐层渐进与温度控制谱退火的神经元对齐方法，可稳定匹配INR置换对称并降低NeRF权重插值损失壁垒。
motivation: 在INR中，独立训练但功能等价的模型因置换对称在权重空间相距甚远，线性插值常出现大损失壁垒；现有离散匹配易陷入局部最优，连续松弛依赖昂贵梯度优化，在NeRF等困难场景不可靠。
method: 方法采用从输入到输出的逐层渐进对齐：每层估计相关矩阵，以匈牙利算法得到离散锚点，并通过温度控制谱退火逐步锐化为置换矩阵；该更新确定且轻量，无需内循环梯度优化，最后以权重匹配逐层精化。
result: 在MLP、CNN和NeRF上可靠恢复神经元对应并实现跨架构稳定对齐；对齐独立训练NeRF模型时，相比现有方法降低权重插值下的损失壁垒，摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该工作为INR权重空间提供确定性、轻量且可扩展的置换对齐方案，提升线性插值稳定性，对NeRF模型合并、编辑等权重空间操作具有潜在价值。

title: AOV-GS: Active Open-Vocabulary Semantic Mapping with 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Robots deployed in human-centered environments need maps that support both geometric navigation and open-vocabulary semantic queries beyond a fixed label set. A key challenge is enriching such maps with semantic information without relying on manually annotated segmentation masks or closed-set semantic categories. Existing geometry-driven active mapping maximizes coverage but treats semantics as a passive by-product of the collected trajectory, whereas active semantic mapping typically depends on supervised semantic segmentation. We present AOV-GS, an active 3D Gaussian mapping system that guides exploration using frozen foundation models. During coarse exploration, AOV-GS re-ranks geometrically promising candidate views according to CLIP mask-embedding novelty computed from SAM instance segmentation, biasing exploration toward semantically informative regions. Frozen SAM and CLIP provide instance masks and language-aligned embeddings throughout mapping, while a lightweight scene-specific language field is fitted offline directly to the collected CLIP embeddings rather than manually annotated masks, enabling open-vocabulary text-query segmentation on novel views. In a controlled comparison using the same SAM-CLIP perception stack, AOV-GS improves average language-field mIoU over geometry-only active planning by 1.3 percentage points on Replica (34.6% on eight scenes) and by 1.8 points on Matterport3D (23.1% on five scenes). With CorrCLIP, AOV-GS reaches 35.6% on Replica, 2.0 points above the matched Geometry-based + CorrCLIP baseline. Novel-view PSNR remains comparable to the geometry-only baseline on both datasets while depth L1 improves on Replica. Code is available at https://github.com/OptimusFaber/AOV-GS.
tldr: AOV-GS利用冻结基础模型引导主动探索，并以离线语言场实现开放词汇3D高斯语义建图。
motivation: 人类环境中的机器人需要同时支持几何导航与开放词汇语义查询的地图，但现有方法要么不依赖人工分割掩码和闭集类别难以实现，要么将语义视为被动副产品，或依赖有监督语义分割。
method: AOV-GS构建主动3D高斯建图系统，在粗探索阶段利用SAM实例分割与CLIP掩码嵌入的新颖度对几何候选视角重排序，使探索偏向语义信息丰富区域；全程使用冻结SAM和CLIP提供实例掩码与语言对齐嵌入，并离线将轻量场景特定语言场直接拟合到采集的CLIP嵌入上，从而在新视角支持开放词汇文本查询分割。
result: 在相同SAM-CLIP感知栈的受控比较中，AOV-GS相较仅几何主动规划将语言场平均mIoU在Replica提升1.3个百分点（八个场景达34.6%），在Matterport3D提升1.8个百分点（五个场景达23.1%）；结合CorrCLIP在Replica达到35.6%，比匹配的Geometry-based + CorrCLIP基线高2.0个百分点。新视角PSNR在两个数据集上与仅几何基线相当，Replica上的深度L1得到改善。
conclusion: 结果表明，以语义新颖度引导主动探索并结合冻结基础模型与离线语言场，可在无需人工标注掩码的情况下增强3D高斯地图的开放词汇查询能力，同时保持几何重建质量；代码已开源。

title: DriftNeRF: Cross-Ray Density Drifting for Sparse-View Neural Radiance Fields
abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) synthesize photorealistic novel views from dense image collections, but degrade sharply when few views are available. We attribute a specific, measurable defect to the objective itself: the rendering loss is a sum over independent rays and contains no term comparing densities that different rays assign to the same region of space, so nearby 3D points can settle on contradictory densities while every training pixel is reproduced correctly. We make this quantity explicit by measuring cross-ray density disagreement directly during training, and show that it stays high in vanilla NeRF, falls only incidentally under frequency-based regularization, and moves together with held-out quality in the sparse regime. We then close the gap with DriftNeRF, a drop-in regularizer that instantiates the drifting-field template on density samples: a masked exponential kernel aggregates densities from nearby points on other rays into a stop-gradient consensus target, and the resulting drifting field penalizes unsupported disagreement while leaving agreed-upon boundaries intact. The regularizer reads only sampled positions, ray identifiers, and predicted densities, so it requires no pretrained model, external geometry, or additional images, and transfers across field parameterizations. On NeRF-Synthetic it reduces residual disagreement by an order of magnitude, and across NeRF-Synthetic, DTU, and LLFF it improves 3-view PSNR over the strongest MLP-NeRF baseline by 0.42-0.65 dB and remains competitive with sparse-view Gaussian pipelines under a matched protocol without their depth, flow, or covisibility preprocessing.
tldr: DriftNeRF通过跨射线密度漂移正则缓解稀疏视角NeRF中独立射线监督导致的密度矛盾，显著提升3视角新视角合成质量。
motivation: 稀疏视角下NeRF性能急剧下降，作者将其归因于渲染损失仅对独立射线求和，缺少比较不同射线对同一空间区域密度预测的项，导致邻近3D点密度矛盾却仍能拟合训练像素。作者显式测量跨射线密度分歧，发现其在原始NeRF中较高，频率正则仅偶然降低，并与稀疏场景的留出质量相关。
method: 提出DriftNeRF，一种即插即用正则器，将漂移场模板实例化到密度样本上：用掩码指数核聚合其他射线上邻近点的密度，形成带stop-gradient的共识目标，惩罚无支持的分歧并保留已一致边界。该方法仅使用采样位置、射线标识和预测密度，无需预训练模型、外部几何或额外图像，并可跨场参数化迁移。
result: 在NeRF-Synthetic上将残余密度分歧降低一个数量级；在NeRF-Synthetic、DTU和LLFF上，3视角PSNR相比最强MLP-NeRF基线提升0.42–0.65 dB。在匹配协议下，其性能与稀疏视角Gaussian流程具竞争力，且无需其深度、光流或共视预处理。
conclusion: 该工作指认独立射线渲染损失缺乏跨射线密度一致性约束这一可测缺陷，并提出无需额外输入、可跨场参数化迁移的DriftNeRF正则器。该方法为稀疏视角NeRF提供即插即用改进，并可能推广到其他辐射场表示。

title: AEON: Unifying Video and 3D World Models
abstract: Current world models for explicit world simulation typically follow two distinct pathways: (1) video generative models (e.g., Sora), which simulate realistic appearances but fail to preserve 3D consistency; and (2) 3D generative models (e.g., Marble), which generate geometrically consistent scenes but often yield static, less realistic observations. We present AEON, a unified framework that bridges video-based and 3D-based world models and combines the benefits of both. The key insight of AEON lies in a generative model that operates within the text- or image-conditioned video latent space while producing renderable 4D graphics primitives---specifically, 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)---as the explicit world representation. We train a 4D reconstruction model to predict both 4DGS and camera poses from monocular videos, serving as our initialized 4D decoder. Furthermore, we design a domain adapter that translates generative video latents into reconstructive 4D latents through a distillation process on the video VAE. AEON naturally supports video-based world modeling by rendering 4DGS at predicted camera trajectories, and constructs a persistent 4D environment with scene dynamics for realistic world simulation. Consequently, AEON empowers a diverse range of world modeling applications and achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. Project Page: https://weiqi-zhang.github.io/AEON
tldr: AEON 统一视频与3D世界模型，在视频潜空间生成可渲染4D高斯表示。
motivation: 现有世界模型主要分为两类：视频生成模型外观真实但缺乏3D一致性，3D生成模型几何一致但往往静态且真实感不足。AEON旨在桥接二者，同时结合视频生成的真实感与3D表示的几何一致性。
method: AEON在文本或图像条件化的视频潜空间中生成可渲染的4D Gaussian Splatting（4DGS）作为显式世界表示。方法先用单目视频训练4D重建模型，预测4DGS与相机位姿作为初始化的4D解码器，再通过视频VAE上的蒸馏设计域适配器，将生成式视频潜变量转换为重建式4D潜变量。该框架可按预测相机轨迹渲染4DGS，并构建含场景动态的持久4D环境。
result: 摘要称AEON在标准基准上达到SOTA，并支持多种世界建模应用，但未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: AEON统一了视频式与3D式世界模型，兼顾真实感渲染与3D一致性，并支持视频世界建模和持久动态4D环境模拟，为世界模型研究提供了新的统一范式。

title: KoalaGS: Complexity-Aware Continuous Level of Detail for Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Deploying a trained 3D Gaussian Splatting scene under shrinking compute budgets requires one primitive set to remain effective when rendered at smaller prefixes. In this continuous level of detail (LoD) setting, the challenge is to decide which Gaussians should retain capacity as the budget decreases. A pilot study on 3DGS-MCMC reconstructions shows that image complexity, computed from the input views before optimization, predicts where reconstruction error concentrates in image and 3D space. It also reveals that simple regions contain too many Gaussians and degrade as much as complex ones at lower budgets, despite being inherently cheaper to represent. Subsequently, in KoalaGS, during training we use this complexity prior to bias relocation toward poorly reconstructed areas while ensuring smooth degradation across LoDs. A primitive importance score then enables inference at low-capacity, while preserving the scene structure. Tested across three datasets, KoalaGS maintains competitive full-capacity quality while significantly improving quality across the budget spectrum, yielding smoother transitions across LoDs, and enabling faster progressive streaming.
tldr: KoalaGS利用图像复杂度先验重定位高斯，实现平滑连续LoD并提升低预算渲染质量。
motivation: 在计算预算持续缩减时，训练好的3D Gaussian Splatting场景需要同一组基元按较小前缀渲染仍保持有效，连续LoD的关键是决定预算下降时哪些高斯应保留容量。对3DGS-MCMC重建的初步研究发现，简单区域包含过多高斯，且低预算下退化程度可与复杂区域相当，尽管其本应更易表示。
method: KoalaGS从优化前的输入视图计算图像复杂度先验，用于预测重建误差在图像与3D空间中的集中区域。训练中利用该先验将高斯重定位偏向重建较差区域，并保证跨LoD平滑退化；随后通过基元重要性分数支持低容量推理，同时保留场景结构。
result: 在三个数据集上，KoalaGS在全容量下保持有竞争力的质量，并在整个预算范围内显著提升渲染质量，跨LoD过渡更平滑，同时支持更快的渐进式流式传输；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，复杂度感知的高斯容量分配可在不牺牲全容量质量的情况下改善连续LoD与低预算渲染，并有利于渐进式流式传输；为3DGS在动态计算预算下的部署提供了实用方案。

title: VLM-Guided Contact Retargeting and Generative Partner Modeling for Humanoid-Human Interaction
abstract: Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.
tldr: REACT利用VLM接触重定向与生成式伙伴状态建模，从人类演示学习可在真实G1上部署的人形交互策略。
motivation: 近距离物理接触时人类伙伴常被遮挡、截断或处于视野外，导致位姿估计失败并依赖外部跟踪或特权人类状态；同时，重度相互遮挡会给用于学习的人-人动捕数据引入误差。因此需要从人-人演示中学习可在真实人形机器人上部署、仅依赖机载感知的交互策略。
method: REACT将语义接触结构作为连接演示处理、交互学习与机载控制的关键监督信号。首先用VLM引导的接触建模与重定向流程识别语义有意义接触并迁移到人形-人几何，同时保持交互结构；随后用交互感知接触奖励学习特权交互策略，并通过逼真人深度渲染蒸馏为仅用机载感知的自中心深度策略。为应对严重部分可观测，还引入生成式伙伴状态建模目标，从被遮挡的自中心视角预测伙伴运动。
result: 在仿真和真实Unitree G1上针对五种接触丰富交互进行评估；语义接触建模显著提升演示交互的保持效果，生成式伙伴状态建模在五种交互中的四种提升接触召回率，且在重度遮挡下最明显。真实硬件上REACT仅凭机载感知完成全部五种交互。
conclusion: 结果表明，语义接触监督与生成式伙伴状态建模能缓解近距离交互中的部分可观测问题，使人形机器人无需外部跟踪即可从人类演示获得可部署的交互策略。该工作为真实人形机器人在接触丰富场景下学习人-人交互提供了可扩展路线。

title: Latent Bridge: From Video Latents to 3D Geometry via Feature Alignment
abstract: Video generation and feed-forward 3D reconstruction typically use separate representations, requiring RGB decoding and visual re-encoding to recover geometry from generated latents. We propose Latent Bridge, which connects video generative latent spaces with geometric feature spaces to directly predict 3D geometry from video latents. We develop representation-specific bridges for Wan2.1 and V-RAE, enabling feed-forward prediction of cameras, depth, and 3D point clouds without the intermediate RGB pathway. Each bridge is trained on RGB videos through feature distillation, while the video encoder and geometry model remain frozen. Training requires neither ground-truth geometry nor execution of the downstream geometric aggregator or prediction heads. At inference, the same video latents support both RGB decoding and geometry prediction. The same trained bridge can be reused for image-to-video and text-to-video generation within the same video latent space, without bridge retraining. Experiments on Co3Dv2 and WildRGB-D demonstrate competitive geometric reconstruction quality, efficient end-to-end generation and reconstruction, and faster latent-to-geometry decoding, highlighting latent alignment as a practical and reusable interface between video generation and 3D reconstruction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hustvl/Latent-Bridge.
tldr: 提出 Latent Bridge，将视频生成潜空间与几何特征空间对齐，无需 RGB 中间路径即可直接预测相机、深度和点云。
motivation: 视频生成与前馈三维重建通常使用彼此分离的表示，需先解码 RGB 再视觉重编码才能从生成潜变量恢复几何，流程冗余且效率受限。本文旨在建立视频生成潜空间与几何特征空间之间的直接接口，省去中间 RGB 通路。
method: 提出 Latent Bridge，为 Wan2.1 与 V-RAE 分别构建表示专属桥接模块，通过 RGB 视频上的特征蒸馏将视频潜变量映射到几何特征空间；训练时视频编码器与几何模型均冻结，且无需真值几何或运行下游几何聚合器/预测头。推理时同一视频潜变量可同时用于 RGB 解码与相机、深度、点云预测，并可在同一潜空间内复用于图生视频和文生视频而无需重训桥接模块。
result: 在 Co3Dv2 与 WildRGB-D 上取得有竞争力的几何重建质量，实现高效的端到端生成与重建，并显著加快潜变量到几何的解码速度；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明潜空间对齐可作为视频生成与三维重建之间实用且可复用的接口，避免 RGB 中间路径并降低桥接模块重训成本。该工作为生成式视频模型直接赋能几何感知与三维重建提供了新思路，代码已开源。

title: Learning from Automatic 3D Gaussian Splatting Edits for Online Bayesian Scene Change Detection
abstract: Online scene change detection requires integrating incoming observations to determine which regions have changed relative to a reference scene. We update change beliefs as new images arrive using generalised Bayesian evidence fusion. However, the prior probability of change and evidence models are unknown beforehand, and numerical Bayesian inference can be costly. We address these challenges by learning offline from automatic edits to a reference 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model. These edits generate labelled training views without manual annotations. Together with unchanged reference observations, they provide supervision for learning scene-specific evidence models and estimating the effective pixel prior and response statistics. Online prediction combines current evidence with historical support, while closed-form local Bayes factors, parameterized by the learned response statistics, update an accumulated 3D Gaussian field. Object-guided refinement produces the final change masks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on PASLCD and CCS3D, with $67.64\%$ and $75.82\%$ mIoU, respectively. On PASLCD, the complete pipeline runs at $17.2$\,FPS over complete query sequences, the fastest among the evaluated online methods.
tldr: 利用3DGS自动编辑离线学习贝叶斯证据模型，实现高效在线场景变化检测。
motivation: 在线场景变化检测需融合新观测判断相对参考场景的变化区域，但变化先验与证据模型未知且数值贝叶斯推断代价高。该方法通过参考3DGS模型的自动编辑生成带标签训练视图，避免人工标注并学习场景特定证据模型。
method: 对参考3DGS进行自动编辑生成标签视图，与未变化参考观测共同监督学习场景特定证据模型并估计有效像素先验与响应统计。在线预测融合当前证据和历史支持，利用由学习响应统计参数化的闭式局部Bayes因子更新累积3D高斯场，并经对象引导细化得到变化掩码。
result: 在PASLCD和CCS3D上分别达到67.64%和75.82% mIoU，取得最先进精度；PASLCD完整查询序列上完整流程运行17.2 FPS，为所评估在线方法中最快。
conclusion: 该方法证明可从自动3DGS编辑中无人工标注地学习在线贝叶斯变化检测所需模型，兼顾精度与速度。其贡献在于自动监督生成、闭式局部贝叶斯更新和对象引导细化，为在线3D场景变化检测提供高效方案。

title: CrossFit-GS: Out-of-Fold Pose Estimation for COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to bypass cumbersome Structure-from-Motion (SfM) by directly reconstructing scenes from unposed image sequences. In this work, we present CrossFit-GS, a deferred-commitment progressive framework that mitigates cumulative trajectory drift and breaks the self-reinforcing loop of distorted-map error propagation. Specifically, we partition the input sequence into interleaved subsets and maintain two complementary submaps. Each candidate pose is cross-refined against a frozen opposite submap that has never been optimized using the target frame, thereby providing an independent geometric reference for pose estimation. Checkerboard validation and spatial coverage safeguards further reject unreliable updates, and only verified poses are committed to their corresponding owner submap. Once the trajectory has been refined, the intermediate submaps are discarded and the final global representation is trained from scratch using the fixed refined poses. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that CrossFit-GS substantially reduces cumulative trajectory drift and consistently improves both camera pose estimation and novel-view synthesis over existing methods.
tldr: CrossFit-GS通过双子图交叉验证与延迟提交，减少无位姿3DGS的轨迹漂移并提升重建质量。
motivation: 无位姿3DGS旨在绕过SfM直接从无位姿图像序列重建场景，但现有方法存在累积轨迹漂移，并会因畸变地图误差传播形成自强化循环。
method: 提出延迟提交的渐进式框架，将输入序列划分为交错子集并维护两个互补子图；每个候选位姿与从未用目标帧优化的冻结对侧子图交叉细化，以获得独立几何参考，并通过棋盘验证和空间覆盖保护机制拒绝不可靠更新，仅提交已验证位姿；轨迹细化后丢弃中间子图，用固定细化位姿从零训练最终全局表示。
result: 在多个基准上的广泛评估表明，CrossFit-GS显著降低累积轨迹漂移，并在相机位姿估计和新视角合成上稳定优于现有方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: CrossFit-GS通过交叉验证和延迟提交打破畸变地图误差自强化循环，为无COLMAP的3DGS重建提供更稳健的位姿估计与场景表示，具有提升无位姿重建实用性的潜在影响。

title: OV-Foam: How 3D Representations Shape Semantic Feature Lifting
abstract: Existing feature lifting approaches for open-vocabulary segmentation rely on simple backprojection to assign features to primitives. In the case of 3D Gaussian splatting reconstruction, the primitives overlap heavily, leading to suboptimal reconstructions, governed by many primitives per ray. Backprojection, however, reduces to a least-squares solvable problem, exactly when no two primitives share a ray. Motivated by this insight, we propose OV-Foam, which uses PowerFoam as the underlying representation. This representation uses a power-diagram to partition the scene, resulting in zero overlap between primitives and a substantial reduction in primitives per ray, which ultimately simplifies the lifting problem and allows for closer-to-optimal feature assignment. We show that the space partitioning primitives of OV-Foam reach near-optimal assignment, and our experiments demonstrate improved open-vocabulary segmentation over Gaussian baselines.
tldr: OV-Foam利用PowerFoam的无重叠空间划分简化语义特征提升，并在开放词汇分割上优于高斯基线。
motivation: 现有开放词汇分割的特征提升方法依赖简单反投影，而3D Gaussian splatting中基元高度重叠、每条射线对应大量基元，导致特征分配次优；反投影仅在无两个基元共享射线时才等价于最小二乘可解问题。
method: 提出OV-Foam，以PowerFoam作为底层表示，利用power diagram对场景进行空间划分，使基元之间零重叠并显著减少每条射线上的基元数量，从而简化特征提升问题并实现更接近最优的语义特征分配。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；作者指出OV-Foam的空间划分基元可达到接近最优的特征分配，实验表明其开放词汇分割性能优于基于Gaussian的基线。
conclusion: OV-Foam表明3D表示的空间划分方式会直接影响语义特征提升质量；通过消除基元重叠并获得近最优分配，它为开放词汇3D分割提供了一种更有效的表示与特征提升路线。

title: Differentiable Task-Driven Coded Aperture Camera Design with 3D Gaussian Scene Representations
abstract: Camera design heavily influences perception task performance, yet cameras are typically designed by domain experts through costly experimentation, in isolation from the tasks they serve. Existing joint-design methods either rely on differentiable simulation limited to pre-captured 2D images, restricting them to optics or image-processing pipeline design, or use non-differentiable camera simulators optimised with derivative-free or reinforcement-learning methods that scale poorly with the number of design parameters. We present a differentiable framework for jointly designing complex camera systems and downstream perception tasks. We use it to design two coded-aperture depth-from-defocus cameras, a monocular and a stereo configuration, by jointly optimising the coded aperture mask, camera parameters, and a depth estimation network end-to-end. Our framework represents scenes with 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructed from real-world captures, providing a differentiable image formation process for gradient-based optimisation over design spaces intractable for prior differentiable approaches. Results demonstrate that our differentiable method improves over existing coded aperture design and non-differentiable camera design baselines, offering a step forward in automated and principled camera design for autonomous systems.
tldr: 提出基于3D高斯泼溅的可微框架，联合优化编码孔径相机与深度估计网络。
motivation: 相机设计通常依赖领域专家反复实验，且与所服务的感知任务割裂。现有联合设计方法要么受限于预采集2D图像的可微仿真，要么使用不可微仿真器配合无梯度或强化学习，难以扩展到大量设计参数。
method: 构建端到端可微框架，用真实拍摄重建的3D Gaussian Splatting表示场景，提供可微图像形成过程。以单目和双目两种编码孔径深度-from-defocus相机为对象，联合优化编码孔径掩膜、相机参数与深度估计网络。
result: 实验表明该方法优于现有编码孔径设计方法和不可微相机设计基线；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作将可微场景表示引入复杂相机系统与下游感知任务的联合设计，推动了面向自主系统的自动化、原则化相机设计。

title: Geometry Regularization for Vanilla NeRF via Self-Supervised Cross-Ray Consistency
abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) achieve high-quality novel-view synthesis by representing a scene as a continuous volumetric radiance field. However, the geometry encoded by the density field of vanilla NeRF can be noisy and inaccurate, since different combinations of shape and radiance may explain the same input images. To reduce this ambiguity, we augment vanilla NeRF with a geometry-optimization branch based on self-supervised cross-ray consistency. Specifically, this branch samples candidate surface points from the density field, generates virtual rays that intersect at each point from different directions, and renders their appearance using the NeRF network. Based on the visibility-weighted color consistency across these rays, we constrain the implicit geometry. We further regularize the implicit geometry by penalizing opacity at candidates with inconsistent appearance predictions and encouraging local normal smoothness. These geometric constraints are derived from the NeRF predictions and require no ground-truth depth or surface-normal supervision. Experiments on eight Replica scenes show that the proposed method reduces the mean Chamfer distance by 30.8% compared with vanilla NeRF.
tldr: 通过自监督跨射线一致性正则化vanilla NeRF隐式几何，在Replica上平均Chamfer距离降低30.8%。
motivation: vanilla NeRF的密度场所编码几何可能含噪且不准确，原因是形状与辐射度的不同组合可解释同一组输入图像，存在形状-辐射度歧义。研究旨在减少该歧义，并在不依赖真实深度或表面法线监督的情况下优化隐式几何。
method: 在vanilla NeRF上增加基于自监督跨射线一致性的几何优化分支：从密度场采样候选表面点，从不同方向生成相交于这些点的虚拟射线，并用NeRF渲染其外观；依据可见性加权后的跨射线颜色一致性约束隐式几何。进一步对颜色预测不一致的候选点惩罚不透明度，并鼓励局部法线平滑；这些几何约束均来自NeRF预测，无需真实深度或表面法线监督。
result: 在八个Replica场景上的实验表明，与vanilla NeRF相比，该方法将平均Chamfer距离降低30.8%。
conclusion: 该方法利用自监督跨射线一致性为vanilla NeRF提供几何正则化，在不引入额外真值监督的情况下缓解形状-辐射度歧义并提升几何质量。实验结果验证了其有效性，并表明其有潜力改善NeRF重建几何的准确性。

title: Radar-Based 3D Human Pose Estimation via Motion-Aware Pose Initialization and Observation-Guided Refinement
abstract: 3D Human Pose Estimation (3D HPE) is used in indoor environments, such as smart homes, to analyze human movement and monitor human states. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar is suitable for this task because it is robust to lighting variations and does not capture images of human appearance. However, radar observations often provide insufficient information about certain body parts or contain overlapping reflections from multiple body parts, limiting accurate 3D joint localization. To address these limitations, we propose the Initialization-to-Refinement Pose Framework (I2R-Pose), comprising two stages: Motion-Aware Pose Initialization and Observation-Guided Refinement. In the first stage, joint-wise features are learned by incorporating temporal relationships across consecutive radar observations and human skeletal structure to compensate for insufficient joint information and estimate an initial 3D pose sequence. In the second stage, separately extracted radar observation features predict joint-wise positional corrections that refine the initial pose and generate the final pose sequence. The framework supports individual and fused inputs of time-Doppler/time-range (TD/TR) maps and radar point clouds (PCs). To evaluate performance across indoor activities, we construct the Radar Motion and Spatial Information for 3D Human Pose Estimation (RaMoS-Pose) dataset, providing synchronized TD/TR maps, radar PCs, and 3D joint ground truth (GT). Evaluations on RaMoS-Pose and the publicly available MVDoppler-Pose dataset show that I2R-Pose reduces mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 39.50% on MVDoppler-Pose and by 15.13% on RaMoS-Pose with fused inputs, compared with the best-performing existing methods evaluated on each dataset.
tldr: 提出I2R-Pose，通过运动感知初始化与观测引导细化提升毫米波雷达3D人体姿态估计精度。
motivation: 毫米波雷达在室内3D人体姿态估计中具有光照鲁棒和隐私友好优势，但其观测对部分身体关节信息不足，并存在多部位反射重叠，限制关节级三维定位精度。
method: 提出I2R-Pose两阶段框架：第一阶段结合连续雷达观测的时序关系与人体骨骼结构学习关节级特征，估计初始3D姿态序列；第二阶段利用单独提取的雷达观测特征预测关节位置修正量，细化初始姿态并输出最终序列；支持TD/TR图与雷达点云单独或融合输入。
result: 构建RaMoS-Pose数据集，提供同步TD/TR图、雷达点云和3D关节真值；在RaMoS-Pose和MVDoppler-Pose上，融合输入相较各数据集最佳现有方法将MPJPE分别降低15.13%和39.50%。
conclusion: I2R-Pose通过初始化到细化策略缓解雷达观测信息不足与反射重叠问题，并在两个数据集上验证有效性，为室内毫米波雷达3D人体姿态估计提供了新框架与数据集。

title: World2HOSI: A Multi-Expert Harness for Long-Horizon Human-Object-Scene Interaction Generation
abstract: Long-horizon human-object-scene interaction (HOSI) is central to embodied AI, animation, and game development. Existing human-object interaction (HOI) and human-scene interaction (HSI) models excel in their respective domains, but none alone covers tasks requiring multiple interaction skills. Training unified HOSI models is hindered by scarce and costly data. We introduce World2HOSI, a multi-expert orchestration harness that generates continuous HOSI data from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and natural language instructions. Our key insight is that long-horizon HOSI hinges not on a stronger single model but on orchestration. Given a shared, structured scene state and an orchestration harness grounded in it, existing experts can jointly accomplish tasks beyond the reach of any of them alone. World2HOSI realizes this insight as a closed loop around a persistent scene state built from decoupled background and object assets. A harness plans action stages over this state, invokes experts via their native conditioning interfaces, and writes each action's effects back, so that every invocation is grounded in the evolving world. To reduce physical artifacts, bounded residual optimization and contact-driven physics simulation further ensure the physical plausibility of human motion and object manipulation, respectively, while preserving interaction intent. Experiments and a perceptual user study show that World2HOSI achieves the best task completion and interaction quality on the evaluated HOSI tasks, while generating more diverse data.
tldr: World2HOSI 通过多专家编排与持久场景状态，从3DGS场景和语言生成长期人-物-场景交互数据。
motivation: 现有 HOI 与 HSI 模型在各自领域表现优异，但单一模型无法覆盖需要多种交互技能的长时程人-物-场景交互任务；同时统一 HOSI 模型训练数据稀缺且获取成本高。
method: World2HOSI 构建围绕持久结构化场景状态的多专家编排框架，场景状态由解耦的背景与物体资产建立；harness 规划动作阶段、通过专家原生条件接口调用专家，并将动作效果写回状态，使每次调用都基于演化中的世界。方法还采用有界残差优化与接触驱动物理仿真，分别提升人体运动与物体操作的物理合理性并保留交互意图。
result: 实验与感知用户研究表明，World2HOSI 在评测的 HOSI 任务上取得最佳任务完成度和交互质量，同时生成更多样化的数据；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作表明长时程 HOSI 的关键在于对现有专家的编排而非训练更强的单一模型，共享且持续更新的场景状态可使专家协同完成单个专家无法完成的任务。World2HOSI 为具身智能、动画和游戏开发提供了可扩展的 HOSI 数据生成路径。

title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF3DGS) reconstructs 3D scenes from images in a single forward pass, making it well-suited to applications that must operate within limited resource budgets. To further improve its practicality, recent budget-controllable FF3DGS methods allow the number of Gaussians to be adjusted at inference, so that the output meets a given storage limit or rendering-latency constraint. However, these methods overlook the cost of inference itself: to produce a representation with the target number of Gaussians, they first predict a dense set of Gaussians and then prune or select from it, requiring nearly constant latency and peak memory regardless of the budget. We therefore propose RLSplat, a resource-linear budget-controllable FF3DGS framework whose representation size, inference latency, and peak memory all decrease linearly as the Gaussian budget is reduced. Instead of pruning or selection, RLSplat learns a Gaussian allocation policy that distributes the budget across local scene regions, so that exactly the requested number of Gaussians is generated. These Gaussians are then refined through resource-linear Gaussian decoding, in which each Gaussian attends only to nearby Gaussians found via an efficient hierarchical neighbor search, so that the decoding cost decreases linearly with fewer Gaussians. In zero-shot evaluation, RLSplat outperforms prior budget-controllable methods at every budget, surpassing the strongest baseline even with 4$\times$ fewer Gaussians, while running up to 4.1$\times$ faster with 9.6$\times$ less peak memory at low budgets.
tldr: RLSplat 提出资源线性预算可控的前馈3D高斯泼溅框架，使表示规模、推理延迟和峰值内存随高斯预算线性下降。
motivation: 现有预算可控的前馈3DGS方法虽能在推理时调整高斯数量以满足存储或渲染延迟约束，但需先生成稠密高斯再剪枝或选择，导致推理延迟和峰值内存几乎不随预算下降，忽视了推理本身的成本。
method: RLSplat 不采用剪枝或选择，而是学习高斯分配策略，将预算分配到局部场景区域并精确生成目标数量高斯；随后通过资源线性高斯解码，使每个高斯仅关注经高效分层近邻搜索找到的邻近高斯，从而让解码成本随高斯减少线性下降。
result: 零样本评估中，RLSplat 在每个预算下均优于先前预算可控方法，即使高斯数量少 4× 仍超过最强基线；在低预算下运行速度最高快 4.1×，峰值内存低 9.6×。
conclusion: RLSplat 实现了表示规模、推理延迟和峰值内存随高斯预算线性下降的预算可控 FF3DGS，在受限资源场景中兼顾质量与效率，为可部署的前馈3D重建提供了新思路。

title: PanoGraphGS: Unifying Panoptic Segmentation and Hierarchical 3D Scene Graphs with Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D scene graphs support language-guided navigation by organizing physical entities and their containment and spatial relations into hierarchical maps. Building such structured maps requires a scene representation that consistently distinguishes semantic regions and object instances across viewpoints. To this end, we present PanoGraphGS, a unified framework that integrates panoptic 3D Gaussian representation learning with hierarchical 3D scene graph construction. The framework learns semantic and instance features on shared Gaussian geometry. Prototype-based semantic learning and association-based instance learning produce consistent panoptic predictions across viewpoints. The learned representation supports novel-view panoptic segmentation and direct Gaussian-level panoptic decoding. A semantic-aware scene graph module further recovers a floor-room-stuff-object hierarchy with containment and spatial relations. We further release NaviGS, a real-world dataset for panoramic scene understanding. The dataset provides 3DGS, mesh, RGB, semantic, and depth data. For 3D scene graph identification, PanoGraphGS outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline in object-node accuracy by more than 50\% points on average across Replica and NaviGS. PanoGraphGS also achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods in 2D panoptic segmentation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of PanoGraphGS in both hierarchical 3D scene understanding and 2D panoptic segmentation. The project website is available at: https://github.com/gaojh0333/PanoGraphGS.
tldr: PanoGraphGS统一全景分割与分层3D场景图，基于高斯表示提升对象节点精度并发布NaviGS数据集。
motivation: 3D场景图可支持语言引导导航，但构建需要跨视角一致区分语义区域与物体实例的场景表示，现有方法难以统一全景分割与分层图构建。
method: PanoGraphGS在共享高斯几何上学习语义与实例特征，采用原型语义学习和关联式实例学习获得跨视角一致的全景预测，并支持新视角全景分割与高斯级全景解码；语义感知场景图模块进一步恢复floor-room-stuff-object层级及包含与空间关系。
result: 在Replica和NaviGS上，PanoGraphGS的3D场景图对象节点准确率平均比最强评估基线高50%以上；在评估方法中其2D全景分割达到SOTA。还发布NaviGS真实全景数据集，含3DGS、mesh、RGB、语义和深度数据。
conclusion: 结果表明PanoGraphGS能有效统一分层3D场景理解与2D全景分割，为语言引导导航等应用提供结构化地图构建方案，并贡献数据集与开源项目。

title: A Head Camera Is (Almost) All You Need: An Electronics-Free UMI Glove Labelled and Observed by One Moving Camera
abstract: Handheld demonstration devices decouple data collection from the robot, but conventional designs burden the hand with a wrist camera, cables and a pose tracker (SLAM, an IMU, a VR controller, or a fixed external camera that the collector's body occludes), and burden the pipeline with as many data streams to timestamp, synchronise and cross-calibrate. We show that a single egocentric camera (USD 122) worn on the collector's head replaces the wrist camera, the pose tracker and their separate streams with one. It reads printed fiducials on an electronics-free glove (USD 22) against paper tiles taped around the workspace, giving the 6-DoF gripper pose and the jaw width from the same frames the policy will see; at deployment the same camera rides a low-cost (USD 120) arm beside the robot that mimics the collector's head from the robot's joint state. Against the robot's encoders the labels are accurate to 6.5 mm and 1.6 degrees median with 93-100% frame coverage, and a policy trained on them instead of encoders pays 3% in validation loss. Adding 194 glove demonstrations to 48 teleoperated episodes lifts rollout success from 10/25 to 17/25, level with 172 teleoperated episodes alone (18/25), and the full co-trained head-camera policy succeeds in 20/25 against 15/25 for the wrist-camera recipe, whose policies drop the object when the goal leaves their view, and 12/25 for a fixed camera.
tldr: 用单个头戴相机读取无电子手套和纸面基准标记，替代腕部相机与位姿追踪器，实现低成本演示采集与策略学习。
motivation: 传统手持演示设备需在手上安装腕部相机、线缆和位姿追踪器（SLAM、IMU、VR控制器或易被遮挡的固定外置相机），并引入多路数据流的时间戳、同步与交叉标定负担。本文旨在用单一头戴自中心相机同时完成演示标注和策略观测，降低硬件与流程复杂度。
method: 在无电子手套上印刷基准标记，并在工作区铺设纸质标记，由头戴相机（约122美元）从与策略相同的视角估计6-DoF夹爪位姿和夹爪宽度；部署时将同一相机装在低成本机械臂上，依据机器人关节状态模仿采集者头部运动。该方法用单相机流替代腕部相机和独立位姿追踪器，并在同一帧中完成标注与观测。
result: 相对机器人编码器，标注中位误差为6.5 mm和1.6°，帧覆盖率达93–100%；用其替代编码器标签训练策略仅增加3%验证损失。在48个遥操作回合基础上加入194个手套演示，使rollout成功率从10/25提升到17/25，与仅用172个遥操作回合的18/25相当；完整共同训练的头戴相机策略成功20/25，优于腕部相机方案的15/25（目标离开视野时会丢物体）和固定相机的12/25。
conclusion: 研究表明，单个头戴相机配合无电子手套和纸质基准标记即可低成本、高覆盖地采集机器人演示，并让标注视角与部署观测一致。该方案减少传感器与同步负担，在少遥操作数据下达到可比或更优的策略成功率，具备替代传统UMI腕部相机与位姿追踪方案的潜力。

title: OmniVLoc: Topo-metric Visual Localization for Omnidirectional Cameras
abstract: Omnidirectional cameras provide surround-view information, significantly overcoming the field-of-view constraints for traditional visual localization systems. However, existing localization systems fail to fully exploit the characteristics of omnidirectional cameras, struggling to deliver accurate and robust localization performance amidst scene content variations and illumination-induced appearance changes. In this work, we propose OmniVLoc, a surround-view localization system based on a topo-metric framework. By integrating state-of-the-art global place recognition and monocular depth estimation methods, we introduce a multi-constrained visual localization paradigm. By solving a scale-aware pose graph and performing precise spherical bundle adjustment, we accurately recover the metric-level pose for each query frame.Furthermore, a hierarchical verification mechanism is designed to filter out erroneous outputs across different stages, effectively bolstering the overall system robustness. Extensive experiments on both public and our custom datasets validate the superior accuracy and reliability of OmniVLoc. To benefit the community, our source code and dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.
tldr: 提出OmniVLoc全景拓扑度量定位系统，结合多约束位姿图与球面BA实现鲁棒度量位姿恢复。
motivation: 全景相机提供环视信息，可突破传统视觉定位的视场限制，但现有系统未能充分利用全景特性，在场景内容变化和光照引起的表观变化下难以保持准确、鲁棒的定位。
method: OmniVLoc采用拓扑-度量框架，融合先进全局场景识别与单目深度估计，构建多约束视觉定位范式；通过求解尺度感知位姿图并进行精确球面光束法平差恢复查询帧的度量级位姿，并设计分层验证机制过滤各阶段错误输出。
result: 在公开数据集和自建数据集上的大量实验验证了OmniVLoc更优的定位精度与可靠性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作提升了全景视觉定位在表观变化下的准确性与鲁棒性，并承诺公开源代码和数据集以促进相关研究。

title: Pair-Free Coarse-to-Real Video Generation via Real-to-Coarse Image Supervision
abstract: Coarse-to-real (C2R) video generation converts coarse animation, simulation, or game-rendered videos into photorealistic videos while preserving scene layout, camera motion, and dynamics. Training such models requires aligned (coarse, realistic) video pairs, which are expensive to create and confine prior systems to narrow synthetic domains. We exploit a simple asymmetry: paired videos are hard to obtain, but paired real-to-coarse images are easy to construct with existing editing and 3D reconstruction tools. Using these image pairs, we train the DINO-R2C model to transfer realistic images to coarse images in DINO feature space, and apply it frame-wise to ordinary real videos to synthesize pseudo-coarse videos. The C2R# model then learns to generate each real video from its pseudo-coarse counterpart, free from needing (coarse, realistic) video pairs. At inference, the DINO-R2C model is discarded and actual coarse videos drive the C2R# model directly. Thus, our pair-free training scales with any real-video corpora rather than with paired synthetic videos. We will release the model and project webpage at https://gonzalognogales.github.io/coarse2real-sharp/.
tldr: 利用易构造的真实到粗糙图像对训练DINO-R2C合成伪粗糙视频，实现无需成对视频的粗到真实视频生成。
motivation: 粗到真实视频生成依赖对齐的（粗糙，真实）视频对，但此类数据昂贵稀缺，使现有系统受限于狭窄的合成域。作者利用真实到粗糙图像对易于构造的不对称性，旨在摆脱对成对视频的依赖，并让训练扩展到任意真实视频语料。
method: 先用编辑与3D重建工具构造真实-粗糙图像对，在DINO特征空间训练DINO-R2C将真实图像转为粗糙图像，并逐帧应用于真实视频以合成伪粗糙视频。随后训练C2R#从伪粗糙视频生成对应真实视频；推理时丢弃DINO-R2C，直接以实际粗糙视频驱动C2R#。
result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果与量化指标。
conclusion: 提出无配对训练框架，将视频对监督转化为图像对监督，使粗到真实视频生成可随真实视频语料扩展并突破受限合成域。其潜在影响是降低数据构建成本，推动该技术在更广泛场景中的应用。

title: Real2Sem2Real: 3D Semantic Augmentations for Robot Learning from a Single Human RGB Demonstration
abstract: Human video scales easily and does not need robot hardware, but existing methods require depth sensing, overlay the robot onto 2D video, or generate data only for the demonstrated objects. We present Real2Sem2Real (R2Sem2R), a real-to-semantic-to-real pipeline that turns one monocular RGB video of a human demonstration into thousands of robot demonstrations across the semantic object instances of a category. R2Sem2R tracks the SE(3) pose of each object with DINOv3-distilled Gaussian splats, outperforming existing methods and FoundationPose with estimated metric depth. R2Sem2R then aligns digital cousins, each generated from one or a few photographs, to the demonstrated objects with a semantic alignment. This alignment matches whole objects and the functional regions of target objects, such as a coffee machine's tray. R2Sem2R maps the human hand to a feasible robot grasp that extends to the cousins. Robot demonstrations are generated either in IsaacSim, for photorealistic rendering, or MuJoCo, for contact physics, and R2Sem2R can generate over 2,000 episodes in about two hours. On two real robots and four tasks, we train a vision-language-action policy on data from one human video per task, and policies trained on our data match or exceed policies trained on teleoperation across diverse object instances. The project page is available at https://real2sem2real.github.io/.
tldr: R2Sem2R 将单段人类 RGB 演示转化为类别内多实例的数千条机器人演示，并训练出媲美遥操作数据的 VLA 策略。
motivation: 人类视频易扩展且无需机器人硬件，但现有方法依赖深度传感、将机器人叠加到 2D 视频，或仅针对演示物体生成数据，难以泛化到同类别不同实例。R2Sem2R 旨在仅用一段单目 RGB 人类演示生成跨语义物体实例的大规模机器人演示。
method: 使用 DINOv3 蒸馏的高斯泼溅跟踪每个物体的 SE(3) 位姿；通过语义对齐将照片生成的 digital cousins 与演示物体及其功能区域（如咖啡机托盘）对齐；将人手映射为可行机器人抓取并扩展到 cousins，在 IsaacSim 或 MuJoCo 中生成演示。
result: 物体位姿跟踪优于现有方法和带估计度量深度的 FoundationPose；约 2 小时可生成超过 2000 条 episode；在两个真实机器人、四项任务上，用每任务一段人类视频训练的 VLA 策略在多样物体实例上匹配或超过遥操作数据训练的策略。
conclusion: 该工作证明 real-to-semantic-to-real 管线可将人类视频低成本扩展为跨实例机器人演示，减少对机器人遥操作和深度传感的依赖，并提升 VLA 策略在类别内不同物体上的泛化能力。

title: V-JEPA Hand: Simple, Accurate and Fast 3D Hand and Camera Trajectory Recovery from Egocentric Videos
abstract: Egocentric video supports diverse applications, including robot learning, augmented reality, and human activity understanding. Recovering metric 3D hand trajectories from such video requires estimating both hand motion and camera egomotion to express the hands in a consistent reference frame. Many existing pipelines recover hand and camera motion in separate stages, combining hand detection, hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and trajectory refinement. We present V-JEPA Hand, a simple feed-forward video model that jointly reconstructs bilateral hand motion and camera motion from egocentric clips. It uses a self-supervised V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to extract spatio-temporal features from full-frame video and a query-based predictor to decode these features into per-frame hand poses, hand presence, and camera motion. We use the predicted camera motion to express the hand trajectories in a common world frame. The model accepts known focal lengths or predicts them when unavailable. It reconstructs each clip in a single forward pass. We train both components end to end in a single stage on a mixture of diverse pseudo-labelled videos and high-precision 3D annotations. A single model achieves the lowest coverage-aware mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) among comparable baselines on ARCTIC, HOT3D, and EgoStandard. It also yields lower world-frame trajectory errors than the compared SLAM-based pipelines. Ablations support the benefits of video pretraining, temporal context, and mixed supervision. V-JEPA Hand achieves a forward-pass throughput of 93.4 FPS on a single RTX A6000. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.
tldr: V-JEPA Hand 用单次前向视频模型联合恢复第一视角视频中的双手与相机轨迹。
motivation: 现有方法通常将手部检测、手部重建、相机跟踪和轨迹优化拆分为多阶段流水线，流程复杂且容易产生误差累积；该研究希望从第一视角视频中联合恢复双手运动与相机自运动，并在统一世界坐标系中表达手部轨迹。
method: 该方法采用自监督 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器从全帧视频提取时空特征，并用基于 query 的预测器解码出逐帧手部姿态、手部存在性和相机运动；再利用预测的相机运动将手部轨迹变换到共同世界坐标系，支持已知焦距或在缺失时预测焦距，单次前向即可重建整个视频片段，并以伪标注视频和高精度 3D 标注进行单阶段端到端训练。
result: 单一模型在 ARCTIC、HOT3D 和 EgoStandard 上取得可比基线中最低的 coverage-aware MPJPE，并在世界坐标系轨迹误差上优于对比的 SLAM 流水线；消融实验验证了视频预训练、时序上下文和混合监督的有效性，在单张 RTX A6000 上前向吞吐达到 93.4 FPS。
conclusion: V-JEPA Hand 提供了一种简单、准确且快速的前馈式联合手部与相机轨迹恢复方案，避免了多阶段流水线的复杂性，在机器人学习、增强现实和人类活动理解等第一视角视频应用中具有潜在价值。

title: PlanarCityLoc: Breaking Silhouette Ambiguity in LoD Aerial Localization via 3D Planes
abstract: Aerial visual localization is crucial for autonomous drone navigation in urban environments where GNSS signals are often degraded. Lightweight textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a geometric map alternative to textured assets. Existing silhouette-based methods rely on image-space alignment, which can leave different camera poses indistinguishable and favor incorrect poses when segmentation errors distort the building outlines. We present PlanarCityLoc, which moves beyond silhouette overlap by leveraging the planar geometry of building facades and roofs. Following geometry-aware initialization, we match image-side planar patches to LoD model planes and use the resulting 3D-to-2D correspondences to refine pose with Perspective-n-Point (PnP). The framework uses off-the-shelf geometry and segmentation models without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on UAVD4L-LoDv2 and Swiss-EPFLv2 achieve state-of-the-art localization recall among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods. By grounding image-space alignment in 3D planes, PlanarCityLoc enables more accurate aerial localization with lightweight, textureless city maps.
tldr: PlanarCityLoc利用LoD建筑平面几何匹配与PnP优化，缓解轮廓歧义，实现轻量无纹理城市模型下的航拍定位。
motivation: 城市环境中无人机自主导航亟需航拍视觉定位，但GNSS信号常退化；轻量无纹理的LoD城市模型可作为纹理地图的几何替代。现有基于轮廓的方法依赖图像空间对齐，易使不同相机位姿难以区分，并在分割误差扭曲建筑轮廓时偏向错误位姿。
method: PlanarCityLoc不再依赖轮廓重叠，而是利用建筑立面与屋顶的平面几何：先进行几何感知初始化，再将图像侧平面块与LoD模型平面匹配，得到3D-to-2D对应关系后用PnP精化位姿。框架使用现成几何与分割模型，无需数据集特定训练或微调。
result: 在UAVD4L-LoDv2和Swiss-EPFLv2上，PlanarCityLoc在所评估的现成LoD-based方法中取得state-of-the-art定位召回率；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 通过将图像空间对齐建立在3D平面上，PlanarCityLoc突破了轮廓歧义，使轻量无纹理城市地图也能支持更准确的航拍定位。其贡献在于无需特定训练即可利用现成模型实现平面几何引导的LoD定位，对城市无人机导航具有潜在影响。

title: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
abstract: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. Achieving this coherence requires both joint reconstruction and aligned supervision, yet existing methods and datasets offer limited support for either. We present EgoXperience, a full-stack paradigm that addresses these needs through data collection, automatic annotation, unified modeling, and benchmarking. Central to EgoXperience is an automatic annotation engine, EgoX-Engine, that couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment, yielding consistent supervision for the camera, scene, hands, and objects. This yields EgoX-Data-6M, a 50-hour dataset of task-driven manipulation and locomotion within and across indoor and outdoor environments, with second-level task captions. We carefully select one hour across these activity categories as EgoX-Bench to evaluate joint reconstruction. To translate this supervision into reconstruction, we introduce EgoX, trained with EgoX-Data-6M and complementary annotations from additional public datasets. Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, our model achieves joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene, hands, and objects in a shared world coordinate frame with a single forward pass. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand-object pose recovery. Against the strongest evaluated baselines, EgoX reduces camera, hand, and depth errors by 68.9%, 65.6%, and 42.9%, and improves object pose scores by 28.0%.
tldr: 提出EgoXperience全栈范式，用自动标注数据训练EgoX，实现第一视角视频中相机、场景、手与物体的联合度量重建。
motivation: 从第一视角视频重建人类活动不仅需要恢复单个3D组件，还需让观察者运动、周围几何与手物交互在同一世界坐标系中保持一致。现有方法与数据集对联合重建和对齐监督的支持均有限。
method: 构建自动标注引擎EgoX-Engine，将几何验证的目标跟踪与基于SLAM的世界对齐结合，生成相机、场景、手和物体的一致监督；据此构建50小时EgoX-Data-6M数据集与1小时EgoX-Bench基准，并训练统一模型EgoX。给定单目第一视角视频和首帧物体掩码，EgoX通过单次前向传播在共享世界坐标系中联合度量重建相机、场景、手与物体。
result: 实验表明EgoX在场景估计和世界空间手物姿态恢复上达到state-of-the-art；相较最强基线，相机、手和深度误差分别降低68.9%、65.6%和42.9%，物体姿态得分提升28.0%。
conclusion: EgoXperience打通数据采集、自动标注、统一建模与基准评测，为一致的世界 grounded 第一视角重建提供数据与方法基础，有望推动具身智能、AR/VR和人类行为理解等应用。

title: DenseHap: Dense Hand Haptic Estimation from Monocular Images
abstract: As dexterous robotic manipulation advances, scalable annotations of human hand-object interactions are becoming increasingly important. Furthermore, previous hand contact estimation methods suffered from issues such as dorsal-side misclassifications and insufficient precision, while lacking a unified framework for integrating multiple hand to environment interaction modalities, including distance fields, contact thresholds, and pressure. To address that, we present DenseHap, a unified end-to-end approach to estimate hand distance field recognition, comprehensive hand contact detection, hand pressure analysis, and hand reconstruction from a single monocular image. By incorporating three distinctly defined heads, along with a pretrained 3D reconstructed skeleton and an enhanced dataset, DenseHap outperforms previous state of the art models on four evaluation datasets, improving the F1 score by 8.5 percentage points (a 16% relative improvement) on untrained datasets and by 3 percentage points (5% relative improvement) on in-distribution datasets. Furthermore, DenseHap has effectively improved short-range hand estimate and pressure evaluation. Code and models will be publicly available upon the paper's acceptance.
tldr: DenseHap从单目图像统一估计手部距离场、接触、压力与手部重建，并在多个数据集上显著超越现有方法。
motivation: 机器人灵巧操作需要可扩展的人手-物体交互标注，但现有手部接触估计存在手背侧误分类、精度不足等问题，且缺乏统一框架整合距离场、接触阈值和压力等多种手-环境交互模态。
method: 提出DenseHap端到端统一方法，从单张单目图像同时估计手部距离场、全面接触检测、压力分析和手部重建；通过三个明确定义的任务头，结合预训练3D重建骨架与增强数据集实现多任务学习。
result: 在四个评估数据集上优于先前SOTA：未训练数据集F1提升8.5个百分点（相对提升16%），分布内数据集提升3个百分点（相对提升5%），并有效改善短距离手部估计与压力评估。
conclusion: DenseHap提供了统一密集手部触觉估计框架，提升了接触、压力与距离场估计精度，为机器人操作中可扩展的手-物交互标注提供支持；代码和模型将在论文接收后公开。

title: PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for 6D Object Pose Estimation
abstract: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer
tldr: 提出免迭代可微的PnP-Transformer位姿求解器，以半稠密2D-3D对应与置信度回归6D位姿，并在BOP上实现低延迟但有精度权衡。
motivation: 经典PnP-RANSAC依赖迭代且不可微，难以嵌入端到端学习流程；本文旨在提供一种免迭代、可微的神经位姿求解器作为替代。
method: PnP-Transformer处理预测的半稠密2D-3D对应场及置信度分数，并将几何输入映射到连续隐空间以回归6D物体位姿；作者将其集成到零样本6D位姿估计流程中，对应模块与位姿求解器分开训练。
result: 在七个核心BOP数据集上取得41.2%平均AR、0.46秒/物体的低延迟，超过RayPose的39.1% AR但低于Co-op的58.4% AR；保持对应模块不变并改用EPnP-RANSAC时，在七个数据集中的六个上更优，达到52.2%平均AR，但每个物体增加60 ms开销。
conclusion: 结果表明PnP-Transformer是一种可行的低延迟、可微神经位姿求解方案，但与RANSAC替代方案相比存在明显精度-延迟权衡；该工作揭示了神经求解器与传统几何求解器在实际流程中的取舍。

title: Rethinking Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting: A Few-Shot Learning Perspective on Overfitting Prevention
abstract:
Sparse-view novel view synthesis (NVS) is essential for AR/VR and real-time communication applications, yet remains challenging when reconstructing 3D scenes from limited viewpoints. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) excels in dense-view scenarios, it suffers from overfitting and geometry degradation under sparse inputs. Current approaches often tackle these problems from a local perspective, addressing either data quality or training regularization individually, lacking a unified and interpretable framework for systematic improvement.
  We introduce a new perspective that reframes sparse-view 3DGS from a few-shot learning viewpoint, treating each Gaussian primitive as a neuron and leveraging deep learning regularization techniques. Under this unified framework, our approach generates more effective supervision from scarce observations through two strategies: (1) data-related supervision enrichment via optical flow-guided pseudo-view synthesis and joint camera-scene optimization; and (2) training-time regularization via motion-aware dropout and early stopping, which suppress overfitting while preserving dynamic-scene stability. Extensive experiments on the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 volumetric video challenge sparse-view dataset demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art optimization-based and feed-forward baselines. Our system won first place in the sparse-view track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 challenge.
tldr: 从少样本学习视角统一重构稀疏视角3DGS，通过伪视角监督与训练正则抑制过拟合。
motivation: 稀疏视角新视角合成对AR/VR与实时通信很重要，但3DGS在稀疏输入下易过拟合且几何退化。现有方法多分别处理数据质量或训练正则，缺乏统一且可解释的系统性改进框架。
method: 将每个高斯基元视为神经元，把稀疏视角3DGS重新表述为少样本学习问题，并引入深度学习正则化技术。具体包括光流引导的伪视角合成与相机-场景联合优化来丰富监督，以及运动感知dropout和早停进行训练期正则，在抑制过拟合的同时保持动态场景稳定性。
result: 在SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 volumetric video challenge稀疏视角数据集上，方法显著优于当前最优的优化型与前馈型基线，并获该挑战赛稀疏视角赛道第一名；摘要未提供具体量化数值指标。
conclusion: 工作提供了统一、可解释的少样本学习框架来系统改善稀疏视角3DGS，结合监督增强与训练正则取得竞赛级验证。该视角对稀疏视角体积视频重建及AR/VR、实时通信应用具有潜在影响。

title: OV-PEAR: Observation-Verified Pose-Scale Estimation and Reconstruction for Unknown Industrial Manipulation Objects
abstract: Fine industrial robotic manipulation requires 6D pose, scale, and an operation-ready 3D model. Existing industrial pose estimation relies on CAD models, object-specific training data, or stable workcells, limiting use with unseen objects; zero-shot methods suffer from single-view occlusion, generative bias, and scale uncertainty. We present OV-PEAR, an observation-verified framework for 3D reconstruction and pose-scale estimation of unknown industrial objects. Its three-stage object-centric pipeline: (1) segments RGB-D instances and generates object-level 3D hypotheses; (2) anchors them to the robot frame via appearance-aware view retrieval, explicit scale search, and visibility-sensitive registration; (3) back-projects multi-view RGB-D evidence into the object-canonical frame to verify voxel occupancy, suppress hallucinations, and produce reusable trusted object models. On BOP-Industrial, OV-PEAR achieves 0.657 average AR and improves pose and voxel-level geometric consistency in real scenes; real-robot connector assembly reaches 99.67% grasp and 84.00% assembly success. The model library and pose-scale log enable short-term object-level state maintenance at 0.02 ms/frame.
tldr: OV-PEAR通过多视角观测验证实现未知工业物体的6D位姿、尺度估计与可信三维重建。
motivation: 现有工业位姿估计依赖CAD模型、对象特定训练数据或稳定工作单元，难以处理未见物体；零样本方法则受单视角遮挡、生成偏差和尺度不确定性影响。研究旨在为未知工业操作物体同时获得6D位姿、尺度和可操作的三维模型。
method: OV-PEAR采用三阶段以物体为中心的流程：先分割RGB-D实例并生成物体级三维假设；再通过外观感知视角检索、显式尺度搜索和可见性敏感配准将假设锚定到机器人坐标系；最后将多视角RGB-D证据反投影到物体规范坐标系，验证体素占用、抑制幻觉并生成可复用的可信物体模型。
result: 在BOP-Industrial上平均AR达到0.657，并在真实场景中提升位姿与体素级几何一致性；真实机器人连接器装配取得99.67%抓取成功率和84.00%装配成功率，模型库与位姿-尺度日志支持0.02 ms/帧的短期物体级状态维护。
conclusion: OV-PEAR减少了对CAD模型和对象特定训练数据的依赖，可为未知工业物体提供经过观测验证的位姿、尺度与可复用三维模型。其模型库和位姿-尺度日志支持高效的物体级状态维护，对未知物体机器人操作具有应用潜力。

title: RxGS: Relightable Gaussian Stylization via BRDF Decomposition
abstract: Reference-based 3D scene stylization transfers the appearance of a reference image onto a reconstructed 3D scene while preserving scene geometry. Recent methods perform this transfer by optimizing the appearance representation of neural scene models including Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). These methods optimize an RGB appearance representation, in which a single per-point colour combines the effects of material reflectance, environment illumination, together with the shading it produces, and the viewing direction. When stylization modifies this combined colour, the illumination effects present during stylization are baked into the stored appearance, so the stylized scene cannot be rendered under different illumination. To address this limitation, we present RxGS, a relightable 3D scene stylization framework built on a Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF)-aware 3D Gaussian representation. Rather than modifying a per-point RGB colour, RxGS optimizes only the diffuse albedo field recovered by inverse rendering, while leaving roughness, metallicity, surface normals, and the estimated environment lighting unchanged. As a result, the stylized scene keeps all the components a physically-based renderer needs other than the edited albedo, and can therefore still be relit. RxGS optimizes the albedo field using a nearest-neighbour feature matching loss together with a spatial smoothness prior over Gaussian centres. We evaluate the method using a Geometry Consistency Cost (GCC) based on optical-flow warping error. RxGS achieves the lowest GCC on all evaluated NeRF-Synthetic scenes and remains competitive on real-captured scenes, while additionally supporting relightable stylization, which existing reference-based 3D scene stylization methods do not provide.
tldr: RxGS通过BRDF分解仅编辑漫反射反照率，实现可重光照的参考式3D高斯风格化。
motivation: 现有参考式3D场景风格化通常优化每点RGB外观，将材质反射、环境光照、着色和视角效应耦合在一起，导致风格化后的光照被烘焙进外观，无法在不同光照下重渲染。本文旨在解决该限制，使风格化场景仍可重光照。
method: 提出RxGS，基于BRDF感知的3D高斯表示，不修改每点RGB，而是仅优化逆渲染得到的漫反射反照率场，保持粗糙度、金属度、表面法线和估计环境光照不变。采用最近邻特征匹配损失及高斯中心空间平滑先验优化反照率场。
result: 使用基于光流扭曲误差的几何一致性代价GCC评估；在全部NeRF-Synthetic场景取得最低GCC，在真实拍摄场景保持竞争力，并额外支持现有方法不具备的可重光照风格化。
conclusion: RxGS将参考式3D风格化与BRDF分解结合，在保留物理渲染所需其他组件的同时实现可重光照的风格化。其贡献在于避免光照烘焙并扩展3D场景风格化的重光照能力，对可重光照神经/高斯场景编辑具有潜在影响。

title: Recurrent Vision Transformers for Event-Based Spacecraft Pose Estimation Under Slow Relative Motions
abstract: Vision-based object pose estimation is vital for conducting spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO). Recent research has demonstrated the robustness of event cameras against the harsh lighting conditions that often occur in orbit, thanks to the extremely high dynamic range of event sensors. However, event-based spacecraft pose estimation (EBSPE) suffers when the relative motion between the chaser and target is slow, since the event rate drops significantly, leading to data with low signal-to-noise ratio. Unfortunately, for safety reasons, real RPO trajectories often involve slow relative motions (e.g., down to 1 mm/s), and operating under low illumination exacerbates the problem. Addressing slow relative motions is thus crucial to raise the practicality of EBSPE. To this end, we propose using recurrent vision transformers (RVT) for EBSPE. The key idea is to exploit recurrent memory to capture longer-term information across sparse event streams, and to learn the temporal attention span from full trajectories rather than fixing the time window. We developed an RVT-based heatmap regressor to produce 2D-3D correspondences for pose estimation, which was validated on real event data collected under slow relative motions representative of RPO trajectories. Results indicate the superior pose estimation accuracy and stability of our RVT-based method, relative to previous per-event-frame-based or fixed-time-window EBSPE methods.
tldr: 提出递归视觉Transformer，利用递归记忆提升慢相对运动下事件相机航天器位姿估计精度与稳定性。
motivation: 事件相机适合轨道强光照环境，但在追逃航天器相对运动缓慢时事件率显著下降，导致低信噪比数据，严重影响事件-based航天器位姿估计（EBSPE）的实用性；真实RPO轨迹常包含低至1 mm/s的慢速运动，低照度会进一步加剧该问题。
method: 采用递归视觉Transformer（RVT）进行EBSPE，核心是利用递归记忆在稀疏事件流中捕获更长时序信息，并从完整轨迹中学习时间注意力跨度而非固定时间窗；构建基于RVT的热图回归器生成2D-3D对应关系以估计位姿。
result: 在代表RPO轨迹的慢相对运动真实事件数据上验证，所提RVT方法相较以往基于逐事件帧或固定时间窗的EBSPE方法具有更优的位姿估计精度与稳定性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作表明递归视觉Transformer可有效缓解慢相对运动下事件稀疏和低信噪比带来的EBSPE性能退化，提升事件相机航天器位姿估计在真实RPO场景中的实用性。

title: MatchCityLoc: Aerial Localization in LoD City Models via Surface Normal Matching
abstract: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) navigation in urban environments requires precise pose estimation. Because Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals are often unreliable in cities, visual localization serves as a crucial complement. Within this domain, textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a lightweight and privacy-preserving substitute for heavy 3D textured meshes. However, localizing against abstract geometry is challenging. Existing pipelines typically score 2D silhouette overlaps, which can suffer from severe geometric ambiguities. We present MatchCityLoc, a framework that shifts this paradigm to direct feature matching from a noisy 6-DoF pose prior. By extracting surface normals from the query image using a zero-shot foundation model and matching them against rendered LoD normals, we establish explicit 3D-to-2D correspondences. This enables a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) pose solve, which we iteratively refine through a render-and-match loop. Experiments demonstrate strong pose recall and accurate translation and rotation among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods with very few renderings. By bridging the modality gap between aerial imagery and texture-free geometry, MatchCityLoc enables accurate localization using lightweight, privacy-preserving city models.
tldr: MatchCityLoc通过图像表面法线与LoD渲染法线匹配，在无纹理城市模型中实现无人机6-DoF定位。
motivation: 城市环境中GNSS信号常不可靠，视觉定位是重要补充；无纹理LoD城市模型轻量且隐私友好，但基于抽象几何定位困难。现有流程多依赖2D轮廓重叠评分，易受严重几何歧义影响。
method: MatchCityLoc从含噪6-DoF先验出发，转向直接特征匹配：用零样本基础模型从查询图像提取表面法线，并与渲染的LoD法线匹配以建立显式3D-2D对应。随后通过PnP求解位姿，并在渲染-匹配循环中迭代优化。
result: 在评估的现成LoD方法中，MatchCityLoc以极少渲染次数取得较高的位姿召回率以及准确的平移和旋转估计；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
conclusion: 该方法弥合了航空影像与无纹理几何之间的模态差异，为使用轻量、隐私保护城市模型进行精确无人机定位提供了新路线。

title: Counting Contributions, Not Views: Occlusion-Aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting grows a dense scene from a sparse initialization through adaptive density control (ADC), driven by per-Gaussian statistics gathered during rendering. These statistics pass a frustum-based visibility filter blind to occlusion: fully occluded Gaussians still count as observed, diluting the averaged gradient signal and suppressing densification precisely where geometry is occluded. We correct this with an occlusion-aware filter that restricts densification statistics to views in which a Gaussian actually contributes, and replace the criterion's raw view-count normalizer with an average-contribution one. Integrated into a StopThePop-based framework, the two together improve every image-quality metric over the occlusion-blind baseline on occlusion-heavy scenes (up to 6% lower LPIPS), at less than half the Gaussians a view-count normalizer requires. Under the longer schedules these large scenes require, the count stays bounded where most criteria diverge, and on smaller benchmarks our method stays competitive at a fraction of the competitors' count.
tldr: 面向3D高斯泼溅的遮挡感知致密化方法，以贡献计数替代视图计数。
motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting的自适应密度控制依赖渲染时统计的逐高斯信息，但现有基于视锥的可见性过滤忽略遮挡，使完全被遮挡的高斯仍被视为已观测，从而稀释平均梯度信号并抑制被遮挡区域的致密化。
method: 提出遮挡感知过滤器，仅使用高斯真正产生贡献的视角来统计致密化信息；同时将准则中的原始视角计数归一化器替换为平均贡献归一化器，并集成到基于StopThePop的框架中。
result: 在遮挡严重场景中，该方法在所有图像质量指标上均优于遮挡盲基线，LPIPS最多降低6%，且所需高斯数量不到视角计数归一化器的一半；在长调度下高斯数量保持有界，在较小基准上以竞争者一小部分数量保持竞争力。
conclusion: 研究表明致密化应统计贡献而非视图，可缓解遮挡导致的致密化抑制，并在图像质量、高斯数量效率和长调度稳定性方面具有优势。

title: PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for Zero-Shot 6D Object Pose Estimation
abstract: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer.
tldr: 提出无迭代可微的PnP-Transformer位姿求解器，在BOP上以低延迟取得41.2%平均AR。
motivation: 经典PnP-RANSAC依赖迭代与不可微操作，难以嵌入端到端或零样本6D位姿估计流程；本文旨在构建一种无迭代、可微的神经位姿求解器来替代它。
method: PnP-Transformer输入半稠密2D-3D对应场及置信度，将几何输入映射到连续隐空间并直接回归6D物体位姿；它被集成到对应模块与位姿求解器分开训练的零样本6D位姿估计流程中。
result: 在七个核心BOP数据集上，PnP-Transformer取得41.2%平均AR与0.46秒/物体低延迟，超过RayPose的39.1%但低于Co-op的58.4%；保持对应模块不变改用EPnP-RANSAC后平均AR达52.2%，在七个数据集中的六个上更优，代价是每物体增加约60毫秒。
conclusion: 结果表明该神经求解器提供了低延迟的可微替代方案，但与RANSAC类求解器存在精度-延迟权衡；其贡献在于可微神经PnP求解器及零样本6D位姿流程集成，并公开代码与预训练模型。

title: ReDT: Resolution-Decoupled Visual Geometry Transformer
abstract: We introduce ReDT, a feed-forward visual geometry transformer designed to scale multi-view reconstruction to high-definition (HD) inputs. Existing visual geometry transformers are typically trained at fixed, standard definition (SD) resolutions and exhibit degraded reconstruction quality and poor computational scaling to high input resolutions. While recent efficient architectures reduce the complexity of inter-frame attention, expensive intra-frame and encoder attention remain largely unaddressed, making HD reconstruction impractical with existing architectures. ReDT addresses both limitations with a resolution-aware architecture designed to scale to high-resolution inputs. The key idea of ReDT is to first map each view to a fixed-size set of basis tokens, compute correspondences in this compact constant-size basis space, and then project the outputs back to the original resolution for dense prediction. By decoupling the internal representation from input resolution during attention, ReDT substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution 3D reconstruction and improves model performance at all resolutions. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets spanning SD to FHD (2K) show that ReDT outperforms state-of-the-art visual geometry transformers in both reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. For instance, on the ETH3D (2K) dataset, ReDT achieves a $16\times$ speedup, a $34\%$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage, and a $33\%$ reduction in chamfer distance over VGGT-$Ω$. \href{https://redt.github.io}{Project Website.}
tldr: ReDT通过固定大小基元令牌在紧凑空间计算多视图对应关系，实现高效可扩展的高清三维重建。
motivation: 现有视觉几何Transformer通常在固定标准分辨率下训练，面对高分辨率输入时重建质量下降且计算扩展性差。已有高效架构主要降低帧间注意力复杂度，但代价高昂的帧内注意力和编码器注意力仍未解决，使高清重建难以实用。
method: ReDT采用分辨率感知架构，先将每个视图映射为固定大小的基元令牌集合，在该紧凑恒定大小的基元空间中计算对应关系，再将输出投影回原始分辨率进行稠密预测。通过在注意力中解耦内部表示与输入分辨率，ReDT显著降低高分辨率三维重建计算成本，并提升各分辨率下的模型性能。
